description: This file defines the RegistrationEmployeeActivationEventProcessor class, which extends AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor. It handles processing registration events related to employee activation by retrieving employee counts and determining event conditions within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: RegistrationEmployeeActivationEventProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes registration events related to employee activation, providing methods to retrieve event type, data, and conditions for saving the event.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the event type identifier for employee activation events.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Gathers data related to employee count and registration details to be used in event processing.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Determines whether the registration event should be saved based on current employee count and threshold.
